operation.summary: This device in one answer, the same shape on every Bridgit platform: what it is, whether it is online, every capability with why it can or can't be called now, and the set-up steps with their state
operation.returns: schema_version, profile_revision (goes up when anything here changes), observed_at, expires_at (60 s later; read again after), device {install_id, relay_device_id, name, device_type, platform, os_version, app_version, api_revision, services, hardware {camera, microphone, speaker, location: present, absent or unknown}}, link, availability {state, in_foreground}, capabilities {v1.<id>: {runtime_id, implemented, supported, enabled, ready, agent_allowed, callable, blocked_reason, constraints {execution}, operations [{method, path}]}}, setup {not_done, steps [{id, state (done, waiting, needs_owner or blocked), where (this_device, approver or anywhere), dependency {kind (os, platform, provider or step), name}, api {method, path} for a step an API completes}]}. A hint, never an authorization: calls are still checked when made
